items.summary: For an f2p experience this is currently sitting within my top 3 gacha games. I've been using a story guide so I can know what to experience chronologically since the game doesn't really give the greatest order on that. The story is to my liking though. The gameplay is also very fun. I love that you can mix and match teams to your liking and create your very own abomination. This also probably one of the most generous gacha's I've played. The devs really do give out a plethora of rewards very very often. I'm very much enjoying my experience and I'll continue playing for the foreseeable future.

items.summary:
I could write an essay about the great things about this game and only include a small paragraph about minor issues that don't really ruin my personal experience with it, but the current endgame rebalance is just abhorrent. 

There is no difficulty for midgame players like there used to be, so it starts off on baby mode and immediately ramps it up to the previous highest difficulty on the next difficulty level with two more still to go. Enemy stats are completely over bloated with no semblance of gradual increase in difficulty and newer players - without resorting to cheesing at least one stage - have no chance in getting the secondary uncap materials in any serious quantity to level up their strongest characters. Having an established account allowed me to at least snatch any rewards that matter, but it was not fun and I can't imagine every bi-weekly reset will be like that, as the current final wave already includes probably one of the best examples of a fight as to why the current rebalance just doesn't work. 

Will change it to positive if we get any decent changes within the next weeks, at latest by the next reset, otherwise it might be time to jump the ship for me. Thankfully I don't really have any sunk cost fallacy in this game, but it is nonetheless heart-breaking seeing it be this mismanaged as it is a game I grew to love and enjoy on a daily basis during the last few months.
